in_genre_works.title: The Mousetrap
in_genre_works.creator: Agatha Christie
in_genre_works.core_dynamic: Snow seals a guesthouse while the telephone line goes dead, so the murderer must be among the people warming themselves at the same fire.

in_genre_works.title: The Hollow
in_genre_works.creator: Agatha Christie
in_genre_works.core_dynamic: The wife is found standing over her dying husband holding a revolver, but the gun in her hand is not the gun that shot him.

in_genre_works.title: The Mystery of the Yellow Room
in_genre_works.creator: Gaston Leroux
in_genre_works.core_dynamic: A victim screams inside a bolted room with barred windows, and the solution hinges on when the wounds were actually inflicted versus when the cries were heard.

in_genre_works.title: The Hollow Man (The Three Coffins)
in_genre_works.creator: John Dickson Carr
in_genre_works.core_dynamic: Fresh snow outside shows no footprints leaving the house, forcing every witness's account of the clock to be re-timed against the moment the snowfall stopped.

in_genre_works.title: Gosford Park
in_genre_works.creator: Robert Altman
in_genre_works.core_dynamic: Servants below stairs see every guest's movement through doors, trays, and bells, while the victim is both poisoned and stabbed by two different hands.

in_genre_works.title: The Moonstone
in_genre_works.creator: Wilkie Collins
in_genre_works.core_dynamic: A smear of wet paint on a nightgown fixes exactly who passed through a doorway during the night, and the house steward narrates what he physically witnessed.

in_genre_works.title: The Nine Tailors
in_genre_works.creator: Dorothy L. Sayers
in_genre_works.core_dynamic: A corpse with no apparent wound is explained by the physical force of church bells rung through a long winter night.

in_genre_works.title: Busman's Honeymoon
in_genre_works.creator: Dorothy L. Sayers
in_genre_works.core_dynamic: A hanging cactus pot and a wireless aerial form a mechanical trap in the house itself, so the killer never needed to be present.

in_genre_works.title: Dead Man's Folly
in_genre_works.creator: Agatha Christie
in_genre_works.core_dynamic: A servant's lie about a trivial domestic chore is the single sincere clue amid a house full of guests performing roles they are not entitled to.

in_genre_works.title: The Lady Vanishes
in_genre_works.creator: Alfred Hitchcock
in_genre_works.core_dynamic: Every passenger denies ever seeing a woman the heroine spoke with, until a name written in breath-fog on a window proves her memory right.

fusion_works.title: The Thing
fusion_works.creator: John Carpenter
fusion_works.parallel_pressure: Snowbound men test each other's blood over a flame because anyone in the room could be the killer wearing a familiar face.

fusion_works.title: Twelve Angry Men
fusion_works.creator: Reginald Rose
fusion_works.parallel_pressure: Locked in a hot room, people reconstruct a crime by physically re-enacting how long it takes to walk across a floor and open a door.

fusion_works.title: Rashomon
fusion_works.creator: Akira Kurosawa
fusion_works.parallel_pressure: Four eyewitnesses to one death give contradictory accounts, each shaped by what they are ashamed of rather than what they saw.

fusion_works.title: The Hateful Eight
fusion_works.creator: Quentin Tarantino
fusion_works.parallel_pressure: A blizzard traps strangers in a single haberdashery with a poisoned coffee pot, and the door must be nailed shut each time it is opened.

fusion_works.title: The Remains of the Day
fusion_works.creator: Kazuo Ishiguro
fusion_works.parallel_pressure: A head servant notices everything in the house yet is bound by station to speak none of it aloud.

fusion_works.title: Alive
fusion_works.creator: Piers Paul Read
fusion_works.parallel_pressure: Snow-isolated survivors must decide within days whom to trust with scarce resources while rescue is impossible.

fusion_works.title: Dead Calm
fusion_works.creator: Charles Williams
fusion_works.parallel_pressure: A couple on a becalmed boat realize their rescued guest's story cannot be true, and there is nowhere to go to escape him.

fusion_works.title: The Dumb Waiter
fusion_works.creator: Harold Pinter
fusion_works.parallel_pressure: Two men in a basement receive orders down a food lift and must deduce from objects what is happening upstairs.

fusion_works.title: Cube
fusion_works.creator: Vincenzo Natali
fusion_works.parallel_pressure: Strangers in a sealed structure discover each possesses one skill needed to escape, while one of them is sabotaging the group.

fusion_works.title: Festen (The Celebration)
fusion_works.creator: Thomas Vinterberg
fusion_works.parallel_pressure: At a father's birthday dinner a son stands up and speaks an unspoken truth, and the guests must choose whether to stay seated.
